Reference image for [[Jokes#Silence_Is_Golden|Jokes]] on [[Silence Is Golden]]: page 186 of a 1901 Macmillan edition of Thomas Carlyle's ''Sartor Resartus'' (1833–34), with the line "Speech is silvern, Silence is golden".
